_comment: Tag-47 Kai — Pinned Sigstore Trust-Root for the Cosign-Keyless-OIDC-Drift-Probe. Operator-Hand refresh recipe lives in docs/operations/cosign-keyless-oidc-drift-probe.md. Schema: wakir.cosign-drift.pinned-trust-root/1. NEVER edit this from a sandbox-CI workflow; only Mira-Hand + Zone-C Tomás cross-review.
notes: Fulcio root CA SHA-256 + Rekor log shard ID are filled in by an Operator-Hand step on a host with Sigstore-network egress; the daily baseline-mode probe synthesises a self-consistent snapshot, so the PENDING values do not trip the trust-root axis. Fixture-mode probes against a live snapshot will assert the snapshot value vs. the pinned value byte-for-byte — once refreshed, drift = the upstream Sigstore project re-tagged the cosign-installer or rotated the Fulcio CA / Rekor shard.
